query: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'sales_header' AND (column_name ILIKE '%customer%' OR column_name ILIKE '%client%' OR column_name ILIKE '%name%' OR column_name ILIKE '%buyer%') ORDER BY ordinal_position;
